training_details.early_stopping_note: Validation only. XGBoost aucpr is its own PR-area metric; final AUPRC(AP) is separately computed with sklearn average_precision_score.
training_details.memory_note: CPU ExtMemQuantileDMatrix with disk pages; validation quantiles reference training cuts.

threshold_selection.rule: maximize validation F1; ties choose highest threshold

protocol.evaluation_unit: Hourly record; original patients remain disjoint across train/validation/test.
protocol.test_role: Exploratory evaluation only; never used for training, early stopping or threshold selection. A fresh holdout is needed for final confirmation.
protocol.validation_role: Original validation patients select XGBoost early stopping and the experiment's maximum-F1 threshold; development metrics are selection-biased.
protocol.feature_ablation: Only the named predictor columns are omitted. Original row order, labels, patient IDs, dataset source and ICULOS metadata are preserved.
protocol.training: The original fit_xgboost implementation and unchanged baseline hyperparameters, seed, training-derived quantiles, class weights and early-stopping rule are reused.
protocol.calibration: Assessment of raw class-weighted model probabilities; no post-hoc calibrator is fitted.
protocol.class_imbalance: Training-only class weights; original validation/test prevalence retained.
protocol.memory: Lazy ColumnSubset selects columns after bounded row slicing; no complete feature-subset matrix is materialized.
limitations: The ablation was motivated by findings on an already examined test cohort; comparisons are exploratory, not fresh independent validation.
Correlated physiological or missingness features can retain timing/source information after explicit time predictors are removed.
Removing ICULOS as a predictor does not remove it as the historical time coordinate used by existing causal preprocessing and evaluation.
Hourly observations within patients are correlated; point estimates do not establish clinical benefit or safety.
